# Card account (`card-account` v1)

A credit card: limit, utilisation, spend by category and statements.

**Group:** Retail banking · **Mnemonic:** `CARD` · **Identifiers:** `CARD-…` in `cardId`

Open one with `CARD <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: card-account
version: 1
description: "A credit card: limit, utilisation, spend by category and statements."
match: { kind: card-account, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Retail banking · Card account, id: $.cardId }
strip:
  - { label: Holder, bind: $.holderName }
  - { label: Product, bind: $.product }
  - { label: Balance, bind: $.balance, fmt: amount2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Limit, bind: $.limit, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Utilisation, bind: $.utilisation, fmt: pct0 }
  - { label: APR, bind: $.apr, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
panels:
  - id: spend
    kind: hbar
    title: Spend by category (this cycle)
    key: F2
    rows: $.spend
    label: category
    value: amount
    fmt: amount2
  - id: statements
    kind: table
    title: Statements
    key: F3
    rows: $.statements
    columns:
      - { label: Closing, bind: "@.closing", fmt: date }
      - { label: Balance, bind: "@.balance", fmt: amount2 }
      - { label: Minimum, bind: "@.minimum", fmt: amount2 }
      - { label: Paid, bind: "@.paid", fmt: amount2 }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.customer, 'customer')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
